visualReview.scope: Permanent detailed exterior and visible stadium bowl.
visualReview.notes: All 17 portable and 17 shared final frames inspected after two corrections. Goal screens are now in front of the catwalk; foyer flights have continuous underside slabs and unobstructed circulation. Full-resolution screen, foyer, mast and cable views complement all-angle review of the fireworks facade, exposed joints, scalloped roof, elevated access circuit and blue/white tiers.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Shared metric concrete, painted metal and membrane remain consistent. Continuous roof XZ fabric UVs avoid independent projection seams. Transparent foyer/inner canopy retains local alpha. Geographic rendering and shared-resource unloading checks passed.

geographicReview.notes: Native +Z follows the exact mapped north-south field axis, fixing western VIP suites on +X. Orthographic placement confirms mapped building base under the wider inverted-cone roof; roof overhang beyond that base is intentional. Exact mapped elevated access circuit and nine branches fit their positions. Native Y0 is field/pier contact; thin access slab burial below zero is reviewed, without a whole-model elevation shift.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed primary-reference exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: Architect PIARENA facade/section photographs, Freyssinet cable details and Maffeis material descriptions constrain distinctive geometry: branching grid, 44 paired cable axes, 20m bowed inner masts, six-cable rings, elevated polygonal circulation and two-tier bowl with western double VIP ribbon. Member inventories, local heights, colour pattern and details are reconstructed from these primary references, not an as-built fabrication model. Private rooms, sponsor images and exact seat inventory are excluded.
